prerequisites: Ability to read and understand texts written in English

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to select, design, deploy, integrate, evaluate, build, manage, operate and maintain hardware technologies within appropriate cost and quality parameters.
Ability to select, design, deploy, integrate, evaluate, build, manage, operate and maintain software technologies within appropriate cost and quality parameters.

Be able to select, design, deploy, integrate and build the hardware infrastructure required by an organization to provide the IT services required by it, according to the stipulated quality parameters.
Be able to evaluate, manage, operate and maintain the hardware infrastructure required by an organization to provide the IT services required by it, according to the stipulated quality parameters.
Be able to select, deploy and integrate the system software and administration tools appropriate for the efficient management of an organization's hardware infrastructure.

syllabus_topics: Virtualization and infrastructure planning of an example organization
Configuration and use of a storage area network

assessment_methods.method: In-person theory tests (TE) (two exams or one final exam)

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, it is essential to obtain at least 5 points out of 10 in each part (laboratory practices, group work, and theory tests). The final grade is calculated as 0.4 x PL + 0.1 x TG + 0.5 x TE. If a minimum grade is not met in any part, the final grade will be capped at 4.5 points. Laboratory practices can only be done in the ordinary call. For the extraordinary call, approved laboratory practices from the ordinary call are considered, and the group work must be submitted and approved; a comprehensive in-person knowledge test must also be passed with at least 5 points out of 10. If laboratory practices were not completed, the maximum grade achievable in the extraordinary call is 6 points.
